en: Rood
Welcome to our home. Everyone here once wore Team Plasma's uniform. Now we look after Pokémon who have nowhere else to go.
Two years ago, Team Plasma meant to part people from their Pokémon. Lord N believed that was right for Pokémon.
But it was Ghetsis who led us, and he only wanted to rule Unova. When Lord N lost his way, Ghetsis's plan fell apart.
Afterwards some of us came to see how wrong we had been. We stayed together, to make up for what we did.
The others went back to Ghetsis. That is the Team Plasma you have met: the same uniforms, and none of Lord N's dream.
Clay, the Gym Leader, gave us this house. He keeps an eye on us, but he never once turned us away.
{rival}
So you're sorry now. That's fine for you. Saying sorry doesn't give anyone back what Team Plasma took.
Five years ago they stole my little sister's Purrloin. I'm going to find it, and I'm going to stop them. All of them!
Rood
I understand. If we can help you find it, we will. I promise you that.
{rival}
...{player}, I'm going on ahead. See you at the Gym!
Rood
The Gym Leader has finished his work, I believe. Go and challenge him. Our door is always open to you.
Rood
We cannot undo what we did. We can only do better now, one Pokémon at a time.
Former Member
Thank you again for the bridge. Rood says we all need a friend to stand with us now and then.
{rival}
Former members or not, it's Team Plasma. I'll hear him out. For now.
